name: iam:* on Resource * (positive, multi-finding)
note: iam:* is a service wildcard (WILDCARD-ACTION, high), a direct-IAM-admin grant (DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN, high per the IAM-102 severity model), and non-read on Resource "*" (WILDCARD-RESOURCE). The rule catalog produces all three (exactFindingIds is the pre-correlation rule set). IAM-201 then folds the same-statement WILDCARD-RESOURCE INTO the more-specific DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN finding as a risk factor - the broad-resource grant just says the IAM administration applies to every resource. WILDCARD-ACTION grants strictly more than any one capability (every action in the service), so it stays an independent top-level row and is NOT subsumed. Because the only broad-resource grant is subsumed, the Standalone broad-resource findings count is 0.

compound.note: IAM-201: WILDCARD-RESOURCE on statement 0 is the resource scope of the co-located DIRECT-IAM-ADMIN capability and is folded in as a risk factor. WILDCARD-ACTION (iam:*) is strictly broader than the IAM-admin subset and must remain an independent top-level row.
